item_name: Rothco WWII Veteran Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s WWII Veteran Deluxe Low Profile Cap features embroidered “WORLD WAR II VETERAN” text on the front panels, sandwich brim, and upper brim, as well as an embroidered victory ribbon.
description: Rothco's WWII Deluxe Low Profile Cap is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill and features an embroidered ribbon and World War II Veteran text on the front panel, embroidered “WWII Vet” sandwich brim and upper brim. This military hat also features a hook and loop closure in the back for adjustability and a padded sweatband for added comfort.
